def loads(__s: str, *, parse_float: ParseFloat=float) ->dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse TOML from a string."""
    parse_float = make_safe_parse_float(parse_float)
    
    out = Output(NestedDict(), Flags())
    pos = 0
    header: Key = ()
    
    # Skip initial comments and whitespace
    pos = skip_comments_and_array_ws(__s, pos)
    
    while pos < len(__s):
        # Skip comments and whitespace
        pos_before_skip = pos
        pos = skip_comments_and_array_ws(__s, pos)
        if pos >= len(__s):
            break
        
        # Check for table headers
        if __s.startswith("[[", pos):
            pos, header = create_list_rule(__s, pos, out)
        elif __s.startswith("[", pos):
            pos, header = create_dict_rule(__s, pos, out)
        else:
            # Parse key/value pairs
            pos = key_value_rule(__s, pos, out, header, parse_float)
        
        # Finalize any pending flags after processing a line
        out.flags.finalize_pending()
        
        # If we didn't advance, we're stuck in an infinite loop
        if pos == pos_before_skip:
            raise TOMLDecodeError("Parser stuck", __s, pos)
    
    return out.data.dict

class Flags:
    """Flags that map to parsed keys/namespaces."""
